extension.name: SFSpeckit — Salesforce Spec-Driven Development
extension.description: Enterprise-Grade Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Framework for Salesforce.
extension.author: Sumanth Yanamala / Evernorth

commands.name: speckit.sf.setup
commands.description: Automated dependency checker and installer (sf, gh, code-analyzer).

commands.name: speckit.sf.constitution
commands.description: Establish Salesforce project principles with 9 articles and environmental discovery.

commands.name: speckit.sf.specify
commands.description: Create a Salesforce feature spec with object maps and security model.

commands.name: speckit.sf.clarify
commands.description: Run the Salesforce gap analysis checklist against the specification.

commands.name: speckit.sf.plan
commands.description: Create a technical plan with force-app structure and blast radius analysis.

commands.name: speckit.sf.stories
commands.description: Generate Jira-ready developer stories with security matrices.

commands.name: speckit.sf.analyze
commands.description: Pre-implementation analysis with Story 00 context and org drift detection.

commands.name: speckit.sf.implement
commands.description: Implement a story file with auto-heal loop and scoring gates.

commands.name: speckit.sf.review
commands.description: TPO and Architect review of generated stories before Jira creation.

commands.name: speckit.sf.change
commands.description: Handle mid-sprint requirement changes with impact analysis.

commands.name: speckit.sf.qa
commands.description: Generate manual test scripts and run automated Apex/Jest tests.

commands.name: speckit.sf.pr
commands.description: Prepare a PR with scoring gates and code review checklist.

commands.name: speckit.sf.verify
commands.description: Generate formal Verification Evidence documents with coverage metrics.

commands.name: speckit.sf.deploy
commands.description: Promote Salesforce code across environments (Dev to QA to UAT to Prod).

commands.name: speckit.sf.score
commands.description: 555-point quality scoring dashboard across all stories in a feature.

commands.name: speckit.sf.hotfix
commands.description: Emergency production bug fix workflow with fast-track deployment.

commands.name: speckit.sf.regression
commands.description: Run full regression tests across all stories in a feature.

commands.name: speckit.sf.release-notes
commands.description: Auto-generate release notes from completed stories and test results.

commands.name: speckit.sf.uat
commands.description: Generate UAT scripts and manage business sign-offs.

hooks.prompt: Run Architect review of generated stories?
hooks.description: Validates story dependency graph, deployment order, merge conflict risks

hooks.prompt: Generate verification evidence for the completed story?
hooks.description: Runs Apex/LWC tests and generates formal Verification Evidence document

config.name: sf-config.yml
config.description: Salesforce project configuration (org aliases, scoring thresholds)
